data.name: Euphemiah
data.gender_notes: Euphemiah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word eu, meaning 'good', and pheme, meaning 'news' or 'reputation'. This name signifies the announcement of good news or a positive reputation. The name Euphemiah carries the meaning “Good News” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Euphemiah usually hope their child will grow to embody good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Euphemiah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Euphemiah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.long_meaning: Euphemiah is a name with a gentle and soothing connotation, derived from the Greek words 'eu' meaning good and 'phemos' meaning to speak. In Hebrew, the name is related to the word 'ephem', meaning to speak or to call. In Christian tradition, the name Euphemiah signifies a person who speaks kindly and gently, and who brings comfort to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Euphemiah is rooted in the ancient Greek language and culture. It was often used as a female name in the Christian world. As a name that suggests good news or a positive reputation, it evokes a sense of hope and optimism.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Euphemiah can be seen as a reminder of the good news of the Gospel. It is a name that reflects the hope and optimism that comes from faith in God and the promises of salvation. Additionally, it can be seen as a reflection of the spiritual reputation that a follower of Christ aims to uphold. Euphemiah is a name that inspires us to be bearers of good news, to bring hope and positivity to those around us.
